counterparts_needing_dossiers.group: se-01 (mainland) or se-02 (Malay peninsula); successor of tambralinga, counterpart of sukhothai-kingdom 1294 gain and c. 1300 loss, vassal of Sukhothai c. 1279-1298, of Ayutthaya from the 16th century, independent 1767-1769, province 1782

problems: restored-hanthawaddy-kingdom: fixed by removing Mon, Kayin and Tanintharyi from the predecessor land, KF0-KF4 and /ledger/0; KF0 is now about 36,700 km2 (was 73,100). first-toungoo-empire (another batch) must trim its 1740-11 loss region (Bago, Yangon, Ayeyarwady, Mon, Kayin, Tanintharyi) to match, otherwise Mon, Kayin and Tanintharyi are held by no state from 1740.

restored-hanthawaddy-kingdom: beyond the reviewer's fix, a Toungoo loss to konbaung-dynasty was added for 1755 (confidence 2, Binnya_Dala) and the 1757 loss, dissolve and successor land were set equal to KF6. konbaung-dynasty (another batch) has no 1755 gain at Toungoo and no 1754-55 gain at Prome.

tambralinga: KF0 split into tambralinga_150 (150-926), tambralinga_927 (927-946, isthmus plus Cliopatria Lavo 806) and tambralinga_947 (947-1276); the Lavo loss moved from 960 to 946, citing Lavo_Kingdom. lavo-kingdom (another batch) has its loss in 928 but ends its own keyframe lavo-kingdom_806 in 927, and here the gain is 927, so 927 is drawn twice; the Lavo page also calls the arrangement 'tributary' and 'vassal', so vassal_start/vassal_end on both sides is the rule-4 alternative. If lavo-kingdom moves its 946 gain, move the 946 loss and the keyframe end here.
tambralinga now has 3 pages (budget 1-2): Lavo_Kingdom was needed for the 946 date and Nakhon_Si_Thammarat_Kingdom was read only for the successor's years (no event cites it).

Remaining cross-dossier mismatches left to a gap-filler: sukhothai-kingdom's 1294 gain and c. 1300 loss with counterpart 'Tambralinga' fall after tambralinga's 1277 end and belong to a Nakhon Si Thammarat dossier; srivijaya and singasari have no dossier yet.
